newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo Q1 gold mines' profit plunges 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Anglo Q1 gold mines' profit plunges 34 pct.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Thursday its gold mines recorded available profit of 224.3 million rand in the quarter to end-March, 34 percent down on the previous quarter.
The group said the fall reflected a seven percent drop in gold production to 50,207 kg and a four percent fall in the average revenue per kg of gold sold to 53,308 rand compared.
Operating profit fell 40 percent to 440 million rand from 744 million rand.
Anglo gold mines' unit working costs climbed six percent to 44,861 rand per kg produced and total working costs fell two percent to 2,252 million rand.
Capital expenditure for the period was 109 million rand lower and the forecast for 1997 has been revised downward by five percent to 828.4 million.
